markets.name: Hammond Farmers & Artisans Market
markets.street: 213 SW Railroad Ave, Hammond, LA 70401, USA
markets.about: Located in beautiful downtown Hammond, the Hammond Farmers & Artisans Market showcases the local producers that make our community special. With a curated mix of local growers and artisans, there's plenty to explore at the market! Saturdays from 8-noon, year-round, rain or shine.
